headline: H.R. 6136 would have funded border security and changed several immigration rules, but the House voted it down on June 27, 2018, so it never became law.
what_it_does: If adopted, the bill would have directed DHS to gain control of the border and added money for a border wall, new ports of entry, and more enforcement staff. It would have created a legal status for some young people who entered the country as children and a point-based path to immigrant status. It also would have ended the diversity visa program and certain family-based visa categories, and it would have added rules on asylum, biometric exit tracking, and protections for children held at the border.

who_it_affects.group: Immigrants who entered the U.S. as young children
who_it_affects.how: Those under age 16 at first entry could have received renewable six-year nonimmigrant status.
The diversity visa lottery would have been eliminated.
Some family-based visa categories would have been removed and the per-country limit for family-based immigrants would have been raised.

who_it_affects.group: Asylum seekers and certain designated gang members
who_it_affects.how: Individuals linked to groups DHS designated as criminal gangs would not have been able to seek asylum, withholding of removal, or temporary protected status.

who_it_affects.group: Children apprehended at the border and in DHS custody
who_it_affects.how: The bill would have added protections against parental separation and for children in DHS custody.

who_it_affects.group: State and local law enforcement agencies
who_it_affects.how: Agencies would have been shielded from lawsuits for complying with DHS detainers, and a jurisdiction that declined a detainer could have faced a private lawsuit in certain murder, rape, or sexual abuse cases.

who_it_affects.group: Travelers at certain airports, seaports, and land ports
who_it_affects.how: Biometric exit data collection and electronic passport screening would have been expanded.

who_it_affects.group: Children of long-term temporary foreign workers
who_it_affects.how: They would have been eligible for immigrant status adjustment under the point system.
